title: Fisher Family Summer Fellows Program
institution: Center on Democracy, Development and the Rule of Law (CDDRL), Stanford University
field: Democracy, development and the rule of law
about: Three-week Stanford CDDRL summer program for mid-career practitioners working on democracy, development and the rule of law. Program dates in July-August 2027; applications and two to three recommendation letters are due 12 January 2027. Selection results by April 2027.
requirements: At least 28 years of age at the start of the fellowship in July 2027
Must commit to attending the full program
At least two and no more than three letters of recommendation, received by January 12, 2027
Nationality restrictions apply (see official eligibility list)

upskill.name: AI Governance Academy
why: No single course objective covers the stated requirements (10 to 12 years of experience, recommendation letters); the closest catalog match is the AI Governance Academy page, not a specific course.

Skill "Governance" / "Public policy" → AI Governance Fundamentals (A016.01): "Explore accountability, transparency, fairness, safety, privacy, security, and meaningful human oversight as core principles of effective AI governance."
Skill "Leadership" → "Understand the complementary responsibilities of executive leadership, business functions, technical teams, legal, compliance, risk ..."
